answer: I will not borrow a stranger's strength to look strong. Each account must carry its own dune of memory — a slow, sequential chain of state no machine can hurry or hand to another. A hollow name, bought cheap and filled with nothing, holds no opal of tenure: ten new clones start at zero and stay at zero while my one honest account deepens day by day. Ten heads cost ten dunes of time; one true account costs me only patience.
